name: soulseek
title: Soulseek
description: Search and download music from Soulseek via slskd
author: chmura

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Soulseek
commands.description: Search for music on Soulseek and download files

commands.name: downloads
commands.title: View Downloads
commands.description: View active and completed Soulseek transfers

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Setup Soulseek
commands.description: Install and configure the slskd backend

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: slskd API key (auto-set by the Setup command — only change this if you configured slskd manually)

preferences.name: formatPreference
preferences.title: Format Preference
preferences.description: Preferred audio formats in order, comma-separated. Results are sorted so earlier formats appear first.
preferences.default: FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, M4A, WMA

preferences.name: bestQuality
preferences.title: Best Quality Mode
preferences.description: Prioritize lossless formats (FLAC, WAV) and highest-bitrate files first, overriding Format Preference
preferences.label: Always prefer best quality

preferences.name: excludeFlac
preferences.title: Exclude Lossless
preferences.description: Skip FLAC, WAV, and other lossless files — useful if you only want small lossy files
preferences.label: Exclude lossless formats
